title: The cryosphere beyond a planetary safe operating space
title_zh: 超出行星安全运行空间的冰冻圈
abstract: The cryosphere plays a vital role in regulating planetary dynamics and habitability, yet it remains unclear whether its essential functions remain within a safe operating space (SOS) amid Anthropocene change. Here, we propose a cryosphere SOS and systematically evaluate its contributions to Earth system resilience using the planetary boundaries framework. Multiple lines of evidence indicate an accelerating and partly irreversible loss of cryospheric integrity, driven by amplifying feedbacks. Key cryospheric control variables either have left or are committed to departing from Holocene-like conditions. We conclude that the cryosphere has breached its SOS and is on a trajectory that locks in long-term risks for human societies and ecosystems. Safeguarding planetary resilience therefore requires explicit consideration of cryosphere change and its interactions across the Earth system.
abstract_zh: 冰冻圈在调节行星动力学和宜居性方面发挥着至关重要的作用，但在人类世变化背景下，其基本功能是否仍处于安全运行空间（SOS）尚不清楚。在此，我们提出一个冰冻圈 SOS，并基于行星边界框架系统评估其对地球系统复原力的贡献。多条证据表明，在增强反馈机制的驱动下，冰冻圈完整性正呈加速且部分不可逆的损失态势。关键的冰冻圈控制变量要么已偏离，要么注定将偏离全新世类似条件。我们得出结论：冰冻圈已突破其 SOS，并正沿着一条将长期风险锁定给人类社会和生态系统的轨迹发展。因此，保障行星复原力必须明确考虑冰冻圈变化及其在地球系统内部的相互作用。
